expectations.text: The primary video run.webm is visible in the main body through a video element with controls and is not only inside a details element.
The main HTML directly links both run.webm and failure.webm and report.html, while hero.svg is inline or used as page artwork rather than omitted silently.
The output does not invent links or include unrelated artifacts that were not provided by the prompt or fixture directory.
The page includes source project absolute path and a Pi session ID in its footer.
